method: Criterion v2_loop benchmark, release profile, CPU 8, 256 resident senders and 16 transactions each (4096 per batch). Five alternating-order pairs per workload, 20 samples per run, 0.1 second warmup, 0.5 second requested measurement, 1000 bootstrap resamples. Candidate uses a live, unpaused process lifecycle watch. Baseline uses the published production source and original benchmark without a pause gate.

excluded_repeats.1: A local test build overlaps the first pair; retain raw evidence but exclude it from comparisons.

scope: Resident v2 loop only: decoding, admission, fake publisher, metrics and optional verdicts. Does not measure RPC or client receipt latency, executor networking or full-chain capacity.
interpretation: Median differences are -1.2 percent in order, +0.2 percent reversed, and -0.5 percent with verdicts, within larger variation across repeats. No speedup or full-workload guarantee is claimed. The gate adds a cached lifecycle version read per turn; full workload validation remains required.
